title: Cooking Volumes - U.S. Unit Converter
description: Convert between US cooking volume units including teaspoons, tablespoons, cups, fluid ounces, pints, quarts, and gallons.

outputs.label: Total Teaspoons
outputs.formula: inputs.teaspoons + inputs.tablespoons * 3 + inputs.cups * 48 + inputs.fluid_ounces * 6 + inputs.pints * 96 + inputs.quarts * 192 + inputs.gallons * 768

outputs.label: Total Tablespoons
outputs.formula: (inputs.teaspoons + inputs.tablespoons * 3 + inputs.cups * 48 + inputs.fluid_ounces * 6 + inputs.pints * 96 + inputs.quarts * 192 + inputs.gallons * 768) / 3

outputs.label: Total Cups
outputs.formula: (inputs.teaspoons + inputs.tablespoons * 3 + inputs.cups * 48 + inputs.fluid_ounces * 6 + inputs.pints * 96 + inputs.quarts * 192 + inputs.gallons * 768) / 48

outputs.label: Total Fluid Ounces
outputs.formula: (inputs.teaspoons + inputs.tablespoons * 3 + inputs.cups * 48 + inputs.fluid_ounces * 6 + inputs.pints * 96 + inputs.quarts * 192 + inputs.gallons * 768) / 6

outputs.label: Total Pints
outputs.formula: (inputs.teaspoons + inputs.tablespoons * 3 + inputs.cups * 48 + inputs.fluid_ounces * 6 + inputs.pints * 96 + inputs.quarts * 192 + inputs.gallons * 768) / 96

outputs.label: Total Quarts
outputs.formula: (inputs.teaspoons + inputs.tablespoons * 3 + inputs.cups * 48 + inputs.fluid_ounces * 6 + inputs.pints * 96 + inputs.quarts * 192 + inputs.gallons * 768) / 192

outputs.label: Total Gallons
outputs.formula: (inputs.teaspoons + inputs.tablespoons * 3 + inputs.cups * 48 + inputs.fluid_ounces * 6 + inputs.pints * 96 + inputs.quarts * 192 + inputs.gallons * 768) / 768

components.content:
## Conversion Reference

### Volume Conversions
- 3 teaspoons = 1 tablespoon
- 16 tablespoons = 1 cup
- 1 cup = 8 fluid ounces
- 1 pint = 16 fluid ounces = 2 cups
- 1 quart = 32 fluid ounces = 2 pints = 4 cups
- 1 gallon = 4 quarts

### Common Measurements
- 1/8 cup = 2 tablespoons
- 1/4 cup = 4 tablespoons
- 1/3 cup = 5 tablespoons + 1 teaspoon
- 1/2 cup = 8 tablespoons
- 2/3 cup = 10 tablespoons + 2 teaspoons
- 3/4 cup = 12 tablespoons

### Specialty Measurements
- 1 dash = 6 drops
- 1 jigger = 1.5 ounces
- 1 pony = 1 ounce
- 1 fifth = 25.6 fluid ounces
